contexts.text: Evil Spirits consider man as a vile slave. Explained.
They who have ruled from the love of self, are vile slaves in Hell. NJHD 73. DP 217:6.
A persuasion is induced on them that they had been vile slaves.
Good works are as slaves to them...
He who supposes that he thinks and speaks from himself... in the eyes of other Spirits is scarcely so much as a slave...
Souls of men properly means slaves, by which are signified the scientific truths of the natural man which are of service to the spiritual. AE 1156, Explained.
They are permitted by the judge to use them as their slaves.
